observations.behavior: Adds a new wrapper function _wrap_select_query_with_column and helper functions to preserve column aliases and CTEs when collapsing a HogQL SELECT query, while retaining bounded ordering and distinct handling.
observations.posthog_connection: This preserves HogQL query semantics and prevents ClickHouse out-of-bounds errors when cohort membership queries are generated. It also preserves bounded ordering and distinct handling, which could prevent incorrect cohort membership results.
